title: CE60133: Environmental Laws, Regulation And Policy
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction, environmental laws and policies - role of government;
Environmental laws for managing Air, water, land, wastewater, solid waste,
hazardous waste, natural resources, energy, ecology and environment.
Environmental guidelines and regulations, environmental auditing, monitoring,
reporting, economics and accounting; Theories of corporate strategy and
environmental policy; Beyond environmentalism, sustainability issues; Role of
government and non-government organizations and citizens.
